items.criterion: Method, communication, cross-document consistency and coordinator integration passes composition/conflict tests.
items.note: Owner-authorized build-first DIA-008 implementation: six specialist reports accepted through DIA-005 typed schemas; source-preserving deterministic coordinator in tools/coordinate_reviews.py, additive coordinated-report.schema.json, complete-link explicit grouping, unresolved disagreement, provenance digests, abstention/negative coverage, offline examples/tests, and expanded 19-file portable bundle with consumer links. Source PR #27 CI run 40417198629 passed full static, schema, reproducibility and refusal controls. DIA-007 actual evaluated reviewer quality and empirical composition remain deferred by owner; suite unreleased; issue In progress, no M3 acceptance or Done point.

items.title: Adopt framework in consumer repositories
items.criterion: Reviewed reversible consumer repository adoption without changing each consumer's authoritative definitions.
items.note: Owner-directed build-first exception: first reversible Diakrisis consumer implementation merged into yigit-denktas/writing-kitchen main at commit 919ebba4e890a05d85cbd2e9a641c6ef11362cb2, PR #24. Seven native skills pinned to Diakrisis source a72b28e25165afc1193fa16ed13a3cd9f8db9afd, 16 source paths with per-file Git blob receipts and rollback guide. GitHub tree verified all 16 installed hashes and eight byte-identical upstream blobs, but Writing Kitchen CI run 40409113960 failed with inaccessible job logs/steps; original main CI also has failures, cause unknown. Hosted snapshot verifier has NOT been observed passing. No model/skill activation, private corpus ingestion, hooks or app runtime integration. DIA-007 still incomplete acceptance dependency; remain In progress, no DIA-M3 acceptance or Done point.

items.title: Version releases and evaluate drift
items.criterion: Versioned skill releases, pinned consumers, provenance/compatibility and update-drift checks established with publication evidence.
items.note: Owner-authorized build-first exception: deterministic nonpublishing seven-skill package builder, pinned 16-file consumer manifest, reproducible ZIP and SHA256SUMS, conservative offline drift/compatibility checks and rollback guidance implemented in PR #26. GitHub Actions run 40410906049 passed structural tests, reproducibility, tampering rejection and nonempty-target refusal. No stable release tag, GitHub Release assets, approved publication/consumer rollout, observed model quality or DIA-008/009 completion. Remains In progress, required work count unchanged.
